description: Repairs r-expr-1/b-mixed-precedence: M held Null, not a Decimal. Asks the same result-type question with M a stored Decimal(28,4): M is read back (VarType, TypeName, CStr, CDbl); then the 26 original expressions in one projection as Field.Type and VARIANT tag, again as VarType, and each expression with M in its own snapshot. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
